1.english_reference: The words of Jeremiah the son of Hilkiah

traditions.WLC: דִּבְרֵ֥י יִרְמְיָ֖הוּ בֶּן חִלְקִיָּ֑הוּ

traditions.VUL: Verba Ieremíæ fílii Helcíæ ,
traditions.KJV: The words of Jeremiah the son of Hilkiah ,

1.english_reference: of the priests that [ were ] in Anathoth in the land of Benjamin

traditions.WLC: מִן הַ כֹּֽהֲנִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בַּ עֲנָת֔וֹת בְּ אֶ֖רֶץ בִּנְיָמִֽן
traditions.LXX: ἐκ τῶν ἱερέων , ὃς κατῴκει ἐν Ἀναθὼθ ἐν γῇ Βενιαμείν ·
traditions.VUL: de sacerdótibus , qui fuérunt in Anathoth , in terra Béniamin .
traditions.KJV: of the priests that [ were ] in Anathoth in the land of Benjamin :

2.english_reference: To whom the word of the LORD came

traditions.WLC: אֲשֶׁ֨ר הָיָ֤ה דְבַר יְהוָה֙ אֵלָ֔י
traditions.LXX: ὃς ἐγενήθη λόγος τοῦ θεοῦ πρὸς αὐτὸν
traditions.VUL: Quod factum est verbum Dómini ad eum
traditions.KJV: To whom the word of the LORD came

2.english_reference: in the days of Josiah the son of Amon king of Judah

traditions.WLC: ו בִּ ימֵ֛י יֹאשִׁיָּ֥הוּ בֶן אָמ֖וֹן מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֑ה
traditions.LXX: ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις Ἰωσεία υἱοῦ Ἀμὼς βασιλέως Ἰούδα ,
traditions.VUL: in diébus Iosíæ fílii Amon , regis Iuda ,
traditions.KJV: in the days of Josiah the son of Amon king of Judah ,

2.english_reference: in the thirteenth year of his reign

traditions.WLC: בִּ שְׁלֹשׁ עֶשְׂרֵ֥ה שָׁנָ֖ה לְ מָלְכֽ וֹ
traditions.LXX: ἔτους τρισκαιδεκάτου ἐν τῇ βασιλείᾳ αὐτοῦ .
traditions.VUL: in tertiodécimo anno regni eius .
traditions.KJV: in the thirteenth year of his reign .

3.english_reference: It came also in the days of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah

traditions.WLC: וַ יְהִ֗י בִּ ימֵ֨י יְהוֹיָקִ֤ים בֶּן יֹאשִׁיָּ֨הוּ֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֔ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐγένετο ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις Ἰωακεὶμ υἱοῦ Ἰωσεία βασιλέως Ἰούδα
traditions.VUL: Et factum est in diébus Ióakim fílii Iosíæ , regis Iuda ,
traditions.KJV: It came also in the days of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah ,

3.english_reference: unto the end of the eleventh year of Zedekiah the son of Josiah king of Judah

traditions.WLC: עַד תֹּם֙ עַשְׁתֵּ֣י עֶשְׂרֵ֣ה שָׁנָ֔ה לְ צִדְקִיָּ֥הוּ בֶן יֹאשִׁיָּ֖הוּ מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֑ה
traditions.LXX: ἕως ἑνδεκάτου ἔτους τοῦ Σεδεκία υἱοῦ Ἰωσεία βασιλέως Ἰούδα ,
traditions.VUL: usque ad consummatiónem undécimi anni Sedecíæ , fílii Iosíæ , regis Iuda ,
traditions.KJV: unto the end of the eleventh year of Zedekiah the son of Josiah king of Judah ,

3.english_reference: unto the carrying away of Jerusalem captive in the fifth month

traditions.WLC: עַד גְּל֥וֹת יְרוּשָׁלִַ֖ם בַּ חֹ֥דֶשׁ הַ חֲמִישִֽׁי
traditions.LXX: ἕως τῆς αἰχμαλωσίας Ἰερουσαλὴμ ἐν τῷ πέμπτῳ μηνί .
traditions.VUL: usque ad transmigratiónem Ierúsalem , in mense quinto .
traditions.KJV: unto the carrying away of Jerusalem captive in the fifth month .

4.english_reference: Then the word of the LORD came unto me , saying ,

traditions.WLC: וַ יְהִ֥י דְבַר יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥ י לֵ אמֹֽר
traditions.LXX: Καὶ ἐγένετο λόγος Κυρίου πρὸς αὐτόν
traditions.VUL: Et factum est verbum Dómini ad me , dicens :
traditions.KJV: Then the word of the LORD came unto me , saying ,

5.english_reference: Before I formed thee in the belly I knew thee

traditions.WLC: בְּ טֶ֨רֶם אצור ך בַ בֶּ֨טֶן֙ יְדַעְתִּ֔י ךָ
traditions.LXX: Πρὸ τοῦ με πλάσαι σε ἐν κοιλίᾳ ἐπίσταμαί σε ,
traditions.VUL: Priúsquam te formárem in útero , novi te :
traditions.KJV: Before I formed thee in the belly I knew thee ;

5.english_reference: and before thou camest forth out of the womb I sanctified thee

traditions.WLC: וּ בְ טֶ֛רֶם תֵּצֵ֥א מֵ רֶ֖חֶם הִקְדַּשְׁתִּ֑י ךָ
traditions.LXX: καὶ πρὸ τοῦ σε ἐξελθεῖν ἡγίακά σε ,
traditions.VUL: et ántequam exíres de vulva , sanctificávi te ,
traditions.KJV: and before thou camest forth out of the womb I sanctified thee , [ and ]

5.english_reference: I ordained thee a prophet unto the nations

traditions.WLC: נָבִ֥יא לַ גּוֹיִ֖ם נְתַתִּֽי ךָ
traditions.LXX: προφήτην εἰς ἔθνη τέθεικά σε .
traditions.VUL: et prophétam in géntibus dedi te .
traditions.KJV: I ordained thee a prophet unto the nations .

6.english_reference: Then said I , Ah , Lord GOD !

traditions.WLC: וָ אֹמַ֗ר אֲהָהּ֙ אֲדֹנָ֣ י יְהֹוִ֔ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ εἶπα Ὁ ὢν δέσποτα Κύριε ,
traditions.VUL: Et dixi , A a a , Dómine Deus :
traditions.KJV: Then said I , Ah , Lord GOD !

6.english_reference: behold , I can not speak : for I [ am ] a child

traditions.WLC: הִנֵּ֥ה לֹא יָדַ֖עְתִּי דַּבֵּ֑ר כִּי נַ֖עַר אָנֹֽכִי
traditions.LXX: ἰδοὺ οὐκ ἐπίσταμαι λαλεῖν , ὅτι νεώτερος ἐγώ εἰμι .
traditions.VUL: ecce néscio loqui , quia puer ego sum .
traditions.KJV: behold , I can not speak : for I [ am ] a child .

7.english_reference: But the LORD said unto me , Say not , I [ am ] a child

traditions.WLC: וַ יֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֵלַ֔ י אַל תֹּאמַ֖ר נַ֣עַר אָנֹ֑כִי
traditions.LXX: καὶ εἶπεν Κύριος πρὸς μέ Μὴ λέγε ὅτι Νεώτερος ἐγώ εἰμι ,
traditions.VUL: Et dixit Dóminus ad me : Noli dícere : Puer sum :
traditions.KJV: But the LORD said unto me , Say not , I [ am ] a child :

7.english_reference: for thou shalt go to all that I shall send thee

traditions.WLC: כִּ֠י עַֽל כָּל אֲשֶׁ֤ר אֶֽשְׁלָחֲ ךָ֙ תֵּלֵ֔ךְ
traditions.LXX: ὅτι πρὸς πάντας οὓς ἐὰν ἐξαποστείλω σε πορεύσῃ ,
traditions.VUL: quóniam ad ómnia , quæ mittam te , ibis :
traditions.KJV: for thou shalt go to all that I shall send thee ,

7.english_reference: and whatsoever I command thee thou shalt speak

traditions.WLC: וְ אֵ֛ת כָּל אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֲצַוְּ ךָ֖ תְּדַבֵּֽר
traditions.LXX: καὶ κατὰ πάντα ὅσα ἐὰν ἐντείλωμαί σοι λαλήσεις .
traditions.VUL: et univérsa , quæcúmque mandávero tibi , loquéris .
traditions.KJV: and whatsoever I command thee thou shalt speak .

8.english_reference: Be not afraid of their faces

traditions.WLC: אַל תִּירָ֖א מִ פְּנֵי הֶ֑ם
traditions.LXX: μὴ φοβηθῇς ἀπὸ προσώπου αὐτῶν ,
traditions.VUL: Ne tímeas a fácie eórum ,
traditions.KJV: Be not afraid of their faces :

8.english_reference: for I [ am ] with thee to deliver thee , saith the LORD

traditions.WLC: כִּֽי אִתְּ ךָ֥ אֲנִ֛י לְ הַצִּלֶ֖ ךָ נְאֻם יְהוָֽה
traditions.LXX: ὅτι μετὰ σοῦ ἐγώ εἰμι τοῦ ἐξαιρεῖσθαί σε , λέγει Κύριος .
traditions.VUL: quia tecum ego sum ut éruam te , dicit Dóminus .
traditions.KJV: for I [ am ] with thee to deliver thee , saith the LORD .

9.english_reference: Then the LORD put forth his hand , and touched my mouth

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּשְׁלַ֤ח יְהוָה֙ אֶת יָד֔ וֹ וַ יַּגַּ֖ע עַל פִּ֑ י
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐξέτεινεν Κύριος τὴν χεῖρα αὐτοῦ πρὸς μὲ καὶ ἥψατο τοῦ στόματός μου ,
traditions.VUL: Et misit Dóminus manum suam , et tétigit os meum ,
traditions.KJV: Then the LORD put forth his hand , and touched my mouth .

9.english_reference: And the LORD said unto me , Behold , I have put my words in thy mouth

traditions.WLC: וַ יֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֵלַ֔ י הִנֵּ֛ה נָתַ֥תִּי דְבָרַ֖ י בְּ פִֽי ךָ
traditions.LXX: καὶ εἶπεν Κύριος πρὸς μέ Ἰδοὺ δέδωκα τοὺς λόγους μου εἰς τὸ στόμα σου .
traditions.VUL: et dixit Dóminus ad me : Ecce dedi verba mea in ore tuo :
traditions.KJV: And the LORD said unto me , Behold , I have put my words in thy mouth .

10.english_reference: See , I have this day set thee over the nations and over the kingdoms

traditions.WLC: רְאֵ֞ה הִפְקַדְתִּ֣י ךָ הַ יּ֣וֹם הַ זֶּ֗ה עַל הַ גּוֹיִם֙ וְ עַל הַ מַּמְלָכ֔וֹת
traditions.LXX: ἰδοὺ καθέστακά σε σήμερον ἐπὶ ἔθνη καὶ βασιλείας ,
traditions.VUL: ecce constítui te hódie super gentes , et super regna ,
traditions.KJV: See , I have this day set thee over the nations and over the kingdoms ,

10.english_reference: to root out , and to pull down , and to destroy , and to throw down

traditions.WLC: לִ נְת֥וֹשׁ וְ לִ נְת֖וֹץ וּ לְ הַאֲבִ֣יד וְ לַ הֲר֑וֹס
traditions.LXX: ἐκριζοῦν καὶ κατασκάπτειν καὶ ἀπολλύειν καὶ ἀνοικοδομεῖν
traditions.VUL: ut evéllas , et déstruas , et dispérdas , et díssipes ,
traditions.KJV: to root out , and to pull down , and to destroy , and to throw down ,

traditions.WLC: לִ בְנ֖וֹת וְ לִ נְטֽוֹעַ
traditions.LXX: καὶ καταφυτεύειν .
traditions.VUL: et ædífices , et plantes .
traditions.KJV: to build , and to plant .

11.english_reference: Moreover the word of the LORD came unto me , saying ,

traditions.WLC: וַ יְהִ֤י דְבַר יְהוָה֙ אֵלַ֣ י לֵ אמֹ֔ר
traditions.LXX: Καὶ ἐγένετο λόγος Κυρίου πρὸς μὲ λέγων
traditions.VUL: Et factum est verbum Dómini ad me , dicens :

traditions.LXX: Τί σὺ ὁρᾷς ;
traditions.VUL: Quid tu vides Ieremía ?
traditions.KJV: Jeremiah , what seest thou ?

traditions.WLC: וָ אֹמַ֕ר
traditions.LXX: καὶ εἶπα
traditions.VUL: Et dixi :
traditions.KJV: And I said ,

11.english_reference: I see a rod of an almond tree .

traditions.WLC: מַקֵּ֥ל שָׁקֵ֖ד אֲנִ֥י רֹאֶֽה
traditions.LXX: Βακτηρίαν καρυίνην .
traditions.VUL: Virgam vigilántem ego vídeo .
traditions.KJV: I see a rod of an almond tree .

12.english_reference: Then said the LORD unto me

traditions.WLC: וַ יֹּ֧אמֶר יְהוָ֛ה אֵלַ֖ י
traditions.LXX: καὶ εἶπεν Κύριος πρὸς μέ
traditions.VUL: Et dixit Dóminus ad me :
traditions.KJV: Then said the LORD unto me ,

traditions.WLC: הֵיטַ֣בְתָּ לִ רְא֑וֹת
traditions.LXX: Καλῶς ἑώρακας ,
traditions.VUL: Bene vidísti ,
traditions.KJV: Thou hast well seen :

12.english_reference: for I will hasten my word to perform it

traditions.WLC: כִּֽי שֹׁקֵ֥ד אֲנִ֛י עַל דְּבָרִ֖ י לַ עֲשֹׂתֽ וֹ
traditions.LXX: διότι ἐγρήγορα ἐγὼ ἐπὶ τοὺς λόγους μου τοῦ ποιῆσαι αὐτούς .
traditions.VUL: quia vigilábo ego super verbo meo , ut fáciam illud .
traditions.KJV: for I will hasten my word to perform it .

13.english_reference: And the word of the LORD came unto me the second time , saying ,

traditions.WLC: וַ יְהִ֨י דְבַר יְהוָ֤ה אֵלַ י֙ שֵׁנִ֣ית לֵ אמֹ֔ר
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐγένετο λόγος Κυρίου πρὸς μὲ ἐκ δευτέρου λέγων
traditions.VUL: Et factum est verbum Dómini secúndo ad me , dicens :
traditions.KJV: And the word of the LORD came unto me the second time , saying ,

traditions.WLC: מָ֥ה אַתָּ֖ה רֹאֶ֑ה
traditions.LXX: Τί σὺ ὁρᾷς ;
traditions.VUL: Quid tu vides ?
traditions.KJV: What seest thou ?

traditions.WLC: וָ אֹמַ֗ר
traditions.LXX: καὶ εἶπα
traditions.VUL: Et dixi :
traditions.KJV: And I said ,

traditions.WLC: סִ֤יר נָפ֨וּחַ֙ אֲנִ֣י רֹאֶ֔ה
traditions.LXX: Λέβητα ὑποκαιόμενον ,
traditions.VUL: Ollam succénsam ego vídeo ,
traditions.KJV: I see a seething pot ;

13.english_reference: and the face thereof [ is ] toward the north .

traditions.WLC: וּ פָנָ֖י ו מִ פְּנֵ֥י צָפֽוֹנָ ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ τὸ πρόσωπον αὐτοῦ ἀπὸ προσώπου βορρᾶ .
traditions.VUL: et fáciem eius a fácie aquilónis .
traditions.KJV: and the face thereof [ is ] toward the north .

14.english_reference: Then the LORD said unto me

traditions.WLC: וַ יֹּ֥אמֶר יְהוָ֖ה אֵלָ֑ י
traditions.LXX: καὶ εἶπεν Κύριος πρὸς μέ
traditions.VUL: Et dixit Dóminus ad me :
traditions.KJV: Then the LORD said unto me ,

14.english_reference: Out of the north an evil shall break forth upon all the inhabitants of the land

traditions.WLC: מִ צָּפוֹן֙ תִּפָּתַ֣ח הָ רָעָ֔ה עַ֥ל כָּל יֹשְׁבֵ֖י הָ אָֽרֶץ
traditions.LXX: Ἀπὸ προσώπου βορρᾶ ἐκκαυθήσεται τὰ κακὰ ἐπὶ πάντας τοὺς κατοικοῦντας τὴν γῆν .
traditions.VUL: Ab aquilóne pandétur malum super omnes habitatóres terræ :
traditions.KJV: Out of the north an evil shall break forth upon all the inhabitants of the land .

15.english_reference: For , lo , I will call all the families of the kingdoms of the north , saith the LORD ;

traditions.WLC: כִּ֣י הִנְ נִ֣י קֹרֵ֗א לְ כָֽל מִשְׁפְּח֛וֹת מַמְלְכ֥וֹת צָפ֖וֹנָ ה נְאֻם יְהוָ֑ה
traditions.LXX: διότι ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ συνκαλῶ πάσας τὰς βασιλείας ἀπὸ βορρᾶ τῆς γῆς , λέγει Κύριος ,
traditions.VUL: quia ecce ego convocábo omnes cognatiónes regnórum aquilónis , ait Dóminus :
traditions.KJV: For , lo , I will call all the families of the kingdoms of the north , saith the LORD ;

traditions.WLC: וּ בָ֡אוּ
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἥξουσιν
traditions.VUL: et vénient ,
traditions.KJV: and they shall come ,

15.english_reference: and they shall set every one his throne at the entering of the gates of Jerusalem ,

traditions.WLC: וְֽ נָתְנוּ֩ אִ֨ישׁ כִּסְא֜ וֹ פֶּ֣תַח שַׁעֲרֵ֣י יְרוּשָׁלִַ֗ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ θήσουσιν ἕκαστος τὸν θρόνον αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ τὰ πρόθυρα τῶν πυλῶν Ἰερουσαλὴμ
traditions.VUL: et ponent unusquísque sólium suum in intróitu portárum Ierúsalem ,
traditions.KJV: and they shall set every one his throne at the entering of the gates of Jerusalem ,

15.english_reference: and against all the walls thereof round about ,

traditions.WLC: וְ עַ֤ל כָּל חוֹמֹתֶ֨י הָ֙ סָבִ֔יב
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐπὶ πάντα τὰ τείχη τὰ κύκλῳ αὐτῆς
traditions.VUL: et super omnes muros eius in circúitu ,
traditions.KJV: and against all the walls thereof round about ,

15.english_reference: and against all the cities of Judah .

traditions.WLC: וְ עַ֖ל כָּל עָרֵ֥י יְהוּדָֽה
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐπὶ πάσας τὰς πόλεις Ἰούδα .
traditions.VUL: et super univérsas urbes Iuda .
traditions.KJV: and against all the cities of Judah .

16.english_reference: And I will utter my judgments against them touching all their wickedness

traditions.WLC: וְ דִבַּרְתִּ֤י מִשְׁפָּטַ י֙ אוֹתָ֔ ם עַ֖ל כָּל רָעָתָ֑ ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ λαλήσω πρὸς αὐτοὺς μετὰ κρίσεως περὶ πάσης τῆς κακίας αὐτῶν ,
traditions.VUL: Et loquar iudícia mea cum eis super omnem malítiam eórum ,
traditions.KJV: And I will utter my judgments against them touching all their wickedness ,

traditions.WLC: אֲשֶׁ֣ר עֲזָב֗וּ נִי
traditions.LXX: ὡς ἐνκατέλιπόν με
traditions.VUL: qui dereliquérunt me ,
traditions.KJV: who have forsaken me ,

16.english_reference: and have burned incense unto other gods

traditions.WLC: וַֽ יְקַטְּרוּ֙ לֵ אלֹהִ֣ים אֲחֵרִ֔ים
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἔθυσαν θεοῖς ἀλλοτρίοις
traditions.VUL: et libavérunt diis aliénis ,
traditions.KJV: and have burned incense unto other gods ,

16.english_reference: and worshipped the works of their own hands

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּֽשְׁתַּחֲו֖וּ לְ מַעֲשֵׂ֥י יְדֵי הֶֽם
traditions.LXX: καὶ προσεκύνησαν τοῖς ἔργοις τῶν χειρῶν αὐτῶν .
traditions.VUL: et adoravérunt opus mánuum suárum .
traditions.KJV: and worshipped the works of their own hands .

17.english_reference: Thou therefore gird up thy loins
